title: Add a ref.mounted check after the await in resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe (tutored_pull_providers.dart)
why: resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe(Ref ref) awaits a DB query and then, on the fallback path, calls ref.read(currentAccountIdProvider) with no ref.mounted guard in between. Per SM-4/Riverpod 3, if the provider or notifier that owns this `ref` is disposed while the getAllUserProfiles() query is in flight (e.g. the reconcile fires during a sign-out or account switch that tears down the owning provider), this throws an uncaught UnmountedRefException from inside a bare async function with no surrounding try/catch at this call site.
recommendation: Add `if (!ref.mounted) return <safe fallback, e.g. -1 or rethrow a typed error>;` immediately after the awaited query, before the ref.read(currentAccountIdProvider) fallback.
acceptance_criteria: resolveOwnerAccountIdForWipe checks ref.mounted before any post-await ref access.
Regression test: dispose the owning container/provider during the awaited DB call and assert no UnmountedRefException escapes uncaught.

corrections: Severity lowered P2→P3: the function is dead code (test-only caller), so the described failure has zero current production cost — not a reachable/live SM-4 gap as framed. Should be resolved alongside whichever fix finding 4 lands (wire up or delete), not tracked as a standalone reachable risk.
